dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Since Elon Musk got involved with Dogecoin, questions have been raised about his influence—balancing responsible leadership and market stability has become more important than ever.

@elonmusk His “day job”—leading SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, and other ventures—is undoubtedly his primary responsibility, but his indirect influence on initiatives like Dogecoin and Web3 cannot be denied.
@cb_doge Elon Musk’s phrase “Call me the Dogefather” highlights his strong influence in Dogecoin and the crypto world. It also shows his confidence in a playful way.
